workflowArtifact.note: Short-lived convenience copy only; the complete per-file manifest is deterministically regenerable from sourceCommit with the command below.

fullPhase8Economics.interpretation: Compares all six stores before any v4 bulk migration with the final all-six-store v4 state. The repair batch alone is slightly larger because the previously omitted small artifacts favor sparse v4 semantics over raw-byte minimization; the full program remains materially smaller.

perFileManifestRegeneration.guarantee: The migration tool records source/target content hashes, expanded semantic hash, join-identity hash, counts and bytes for every discovered artifact and is deterministic from the immutable source commit.

refereeValidation.reason: The temporary workflow used `node ... | tee` without pipefail, so the validator process exit could have been masked; its uploaded text file was empty.
refereeValidation.requiredClosingProof: A later exact-head Hint/provenance hostile audit must run `check:hint-store-census` and `check:all-hint-store-referee` without a masking pipeline and succeed.
